# Maku Mazakpe

> AI-native software engineer in Accra, Ghana. 5+ years shipping production Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, backend and multi-LLM AI systems across fintech and agriculture. Founder & Lead Engineer of StartupTribunal; Senior Mobile Developer at Farmerline Group. Open to senior IC, Forward Deployed Engineer and consulting work.
